verdict.rationale: Brex Travel offers in-platform booking from global inventory with auto-enforced expense policies on the same platform (brex-docs-39). Booking objects carry a `policy` field showing whether a booking was out of policy and which travel rules it broke, so policy is evaluated per booking (brex-docs-6). A community user also confirms using Brex Travel (brex-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that flights and hotels specifically are bookable, clarity on whether out-of-policy bookings are blocked or pre-approved at booking time rather than only flagged, and in-depth first-party travel docs.
